---
title: Lists of floats
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    list-of: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -q 'List of Figures' && pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -q 'List of Tables' && pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -q 'List of Listings' && test "$(grep -c '^#let typst-extras-list-of' "${EXTENSION_TEST_INPUT%.qmd}.typ")" = 1
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - - 'typst-extras-list-of\('
          - '"quarto-float-fig".*"quarto-float-tbl".*"quarto-float-lst"'
          - 'List of Figures'
          - 'List of Tables'
          - 'List of Listings'
        - - 'page-break: true'
---
